segments.he: אוֹכְלִין וְשׁוֹתִין מִשֶּׁחָשֵׁיכָה כּוּ׳. אָמַר רַבִּי זְעֵירָא אָמַר רַב הוּנָא: יָחִיד שֶׁקִּיבֵּל עָלָיו תַּעֲנִית, אֲפִילּוּ אָכַל וְשָׁתָה כׇּל הַלַּיְלָה — לְמָחָר הוּא מִתְפַּלֵּל תְּפִילַּת תַּעֲנִית. לָן בְּתַעֲנִיתוֹ — אֵינוֹ מִתְפַּלֵּל שֶׁל תַּעֲנִית.
segments.en: § The mishna taught that during the first set of fasts «they eat and drink from after dark,» and begin fasting in the morning. «Rabbi Zeira said» that «Rav Huna said:» With regard to «an individual who took a fast upon himself, even» if «he ate and drank the entire night, on the following day he prays» in the Amida «the prayer of a fast,» which begins: Answer us on the day of our fast. If after completing his fast he «slept in his fast,» i.e., he continued fasting throughout the night, «he does not pray» the prayer «of a fast» the next morning.

positions.claim: one who ate all night still says the fast prayer next day; one who fasted through the night does not say it the next morning
